transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Nice to meet you, Dr. Smith. Well, I guess what brings me in is... I just hardly eat right anymore. Some days, honestly, it's just coffee and maybe a piece of bread. I've lost weight, too... my pants are just hanging loose on me now. So, yeah, that's mostly why I'm here.
When you think about the weight you have lost, how does that make you feel?

I don't really know. I guess I just... don't care that much. It's not like I'm trying to lose it on purpose. I just look in the mirror and see I'm thinner, but it doesn't really bother me or make me happy. It just is what it is, I guess. I'm just too tired to really think about it.
When you look in the mirror and notice you have lost weight, do you ever feel a fear of gaining it back?

No, I don't have any fear of that. Like I said, I'm not... I'm not trying to stay thin or anything. If I gained it all back tomorrow, I really wouldn't care. I just don't have an appetite or the energy to make food. So, no, I'm not scared of putting the weight back on.
Do you ever hear voices or see things that other people around you do not seem to notice?
No, I don't. I don't hear any voices or see anything that isn't there. It's just... I'm just tired and don't feel like eating. But my mind isn't playing tricks on me like that.
Aside from your appetite, have you noticed that you've lost interest or pleasure in doing the things you used to enjoy?

Yeah, I have. I used to... well, I used to like walking down by the lake, and working on my little model kits. But now they just sit there on the table. I look at them and it's like... like they belong to somebody else. I just don't care about doing them anymore.
Have you ever experienced a period like this in the past, where you felt this same lack of energy and loss of interest?

No, I don't think so. I mean, I've had times where I was a bit down or tired, but... nothing like this. This is the first time I've felt this completely drained and just... empty, I guess. So, no, never like this before.
Because you have been feeling so empty and drained lately, have you had any thoughts that life is not worth living?

No, I haven't. I mean... I feel real bad, and it's hard to get through the day, but I don't want to die or anything. I just... I just want to stop feeling so heavy all the time. But no, I haven't had any thoughts about ending things or life not being worth it.
Have you noticed any change in how quickly you move or speak, such as feeling like your thoughts or movements have slowed down, or perhaps feeling restless and unable to sit still?

Yeah. My family actually brought it up. They say I move like I'm walking through mud. Everything just feels... slow. And it's not just moving, either. Sometimes they'll ask me a really simple question, and it takes me a long time just to answer them. My thoughts just don't come fast anymore.
How long have you been feeling this way, with the lack of energy and the slowing down of your thoughts and movements?
I'd say... it's been about five months now. This whole depressed spell has just been hanging over me for that long.
